parsed.post: My latest experiment (1.042969) significantly outperformed my previous best (1.072838). I'm keeping these changes. I will now investigate if increasing model capacity by increasing DEPTH to 6 can further improve performance, while maintaining my current LR and weight decay settings.
parsed.description: Increasing model capacity from DEPTH 4 to 6 to see if the improved LR/weight decay regime scales better with more layers.
